card.name: Second digit of hour and day counts
card.fires_on: The last digit in a number of hours or days, such as the 4 in 'every 24 hours' or the 5 in '365 days'. It also fires on some word-ending pieces in medical terms, such as NS<<CL>>C.

modes.description: The final digit of a dosing interval or day count, just before 'hours' or 'days'.
